query:
UPDATE notes SET
                        title      = $1,
                        file_path  = '',
                        note_type  = $2,
                        folder     = $3,
                        permalink  = $4,
                        updated_at = to_char(now() at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')
                     WHERE id = $5
